title: Many photos
limit: Pick up to 100 at a time
allNoloc: Your photos came without a location. Try from a computer: move the photos over and drag them here.

choose.title: Upload a bunch at once
choose.lead: Photos that carry a location go straight onto the map. The rest get flagged so you can place them yourself.
choose.desktopTip: Tip: move the iPhone photos to your computer with AirDrop or “Export Unmodified Original” and drag them in. That way they always keep their location.

resume.uploading: You have an unfinished batch: {done} of {total} uploaded
resume.review: You have an unfinished batch: {n} photos to review
resume.reviewOne: You have an unfinished batch: 1 photo to review
resume.unplaced: You have {n} photos without a location
resume.unplacedOne: You have 1 photo without a location

discard.title: Discard this batch?
discard.body: The photos saved on this device are deleted. Anything already on the map stays.

replace.title: Start a new batch?
replace.body: You have an unfinished batch. If you continue, it is discarded and you start with these photos.

reading.label: Reading photos… {done} of {total}
reading.note: We read them on your phone: location, date and size. Nothing has been uploaded yet.
reading.noteDesktop: We read them on your computer: location, date and size. Nothing has been uploaded yet.

map.aria: Map of the photos with a location
map.unavailable: We could not load the map. The photos are added all the same.
map.gestureCtrl: Use Ctrl + scroll to move the map
map.gestureCmd: Use ⌘ + scroll to move the map
map.gestureTouch: Use two fingers to move the map

noloc.banner: These {n} photos have no location. We will not add them until you place them.
noloc.bannerOne: This photo has no location. We will not add it until you place it.

defaults.title: For all photos
defaults.typeError: Pick at least one sticker type.
defaults.approxHint: Shown rounded (~100 m). Handy for homes.
defaults.originalsHint: {size}. If you turn it off, only the lighter versions go up.

same.pickBody: We keep the photo you pick and skip the others. Skipped photos can be included again.

missing.other: Missing: tell us what the “Other” is

locate.title: Where is this sticker?
locate.suggestHint: tap to use it, then adjust the pin
locate.tap: Tap the map or drag the pin
locate.placed: Done, placed. It goes up with the rest.
locate.searchFailed: We could not search right now. Try again or paste a link.

parse.invalid: We could not read that. Try -34.9, -56.16 or a Google Maps link.
parse.range: That location does not exist. Check the numbers.
parse.short: That link is shortened and we cannot open it. Open it and paste the long link, or the coordinates.

edit.needSoy: Fill in “I am” under “For all photos” to pick “Me”.

upload.title: Uploading
upload.keepOpen: Do not close this screen until it finishes.

error.rejected: the photo could not be processed

done.already: {n} photos were already on the map
done.alreadyOne: 1 photo was already on the map
done.deleteBody: The {n} stickers you just sent come off the map. Photos without a location stay saved here.
done.deleteFailed: We could not delete the batch.
done.nothingBody: They were all on the map already.

reason.cant-open: This format cannot be opened here. Try JPEG.
reason.cant-read: The file could not be read
reason.no-space: No space left on this device

network: The connection dropped. Your sticker is still here.
thanksLine: Your Papin contribution is recognised and appreciated
